identity_features.eye_style: white embedded eyeballs with brown pupils
identity_features.mouth: visible mouth cavity with two fangs and centered tongue
identity_features.skin_pattern: jagged tiger stripes conforming to surface

tsa_locks.family_base_rule: Arya body and head remain on the Rangga family baseline; only cosmetics/accessories differ.
tsa_locks.eye_depth_rule: Eyes must sit in real sockets and never read as flat stickers.
tsa_locks.arm_anatomy_rule: Every arm preserves shoulder, upper arm, elbow, forearm, wrist and hand.
tsa_locks.leg_anatomy_rule: Every leg preserves thigh, knee, calf, ankle and foot even at compact scale.
tsa_locks.hand_pose_rule: Both hands use neutral healthy anatomy; no weapon-grip pose and no detached prop interaction.
tsa_locks.skin_mark_rule: Tiger stripes must conform to body curvature, not appear as detached floating plates.
tsa_locks.static_gate: No rig or animation until canonical anatomy and form are approved.
